title: OLEANDER Structural Engineering Design Process v1.0
purpose: Run authentic structural-engineering development from strategic definition through use while preserving IStructE Structural Plan of Work stage semantics, task/claim knowledge mounts, cross-disciplinary interfaces, native engineering outputs, actual readback and risk-proportionate checking.
scope_in: loads, stability, load paths, robustness and serviceability
structural materials, members, connections and tolerances
manufacturing/construction structural support and conformity evidence
scope_out: geotechnical engineering outside assigned structural interface
fire-engineering approval outside assigned structural interface
authority_position: Subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Professional Domain Process Contract, Current Knowledge Authority, Cross-Disciplinary Integration and the responsible structural engineer / jurisdiction authority.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim requires structural-engineering feasibility, design, coordination, production, construction, handover or use-stage judgment.
responsibility_triggers: structural shared variable consumed by another profession
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable current claim ceiling across mounted source evidence, structural stage evidence, checking, integration and external professional/statutory authority governs.
not_triggered_when: decorative or non-authoritative structural-looking geometry with explicit exclusion of engineering feasibility

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential structural knowledge, standards, survey/geotechnical facts, existing-condition evidence and product/system evidence must be admitted through task/claim-scoped operational mounts before they support a professional decision.
required_methods: current OLEANDER structural engineering / safety routing
precedent_case_routes: bounded structural precedent only where applicability is established
practice_routes: current OLEANDER structural practice / failure evidence
tool_knowledge_routes: current structural analysis / CAD / BIM execution capability guidance when used

stages.professional_question: What structural consequences, opportunities and uncertainty materially affect the strategic project decision?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential site/existing-condition and structural strategic sources before making a structural feasibility claim.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: strategic project brief plus structural strategic constraints
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when use, development strategy, extent or major geometry materially changes.

content_projection_requirements: show strategic constraints and evidence state
required_readback: read strategic decision against actual site/existing-condition evidence state
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent structural review when project consequence/novelty/authority requires it; otherwise explicit checking strategy must be recorded.
open_items_allowed: later detailed structural design and verification
exit_conditions: material strategic structural constraints identified and unknowns explicit

stages.professional_question: Is there an authoritative enough structural brief, information basis and responsibility boundary to begin concept design?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential site, geotechnical, existing-condition and code-route inputs at the current task/claim ceiling.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current geotechnical/survey evidence and Structural Basis of Design
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when geotechnical authority, investigation or ground model changes.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current project/architectural brief plus structural brief
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when brief, use, grid/span/level/core/void intent materially changes.

technical_consequences: information and responsibility basis for concept design
content_projection_requirements: show authority state, information gaps and responsibility boundaries
required_readback: read current brief and source authority against structural information requirements
stages.independent_review_requirement: Review responsibility, investigation and checking strategy separately from producer intent where risk requires.
exit_conditions: critical information responsibilities and investigation gaps explicit
reopen_triggers: brief, survey, code or responsibility change

stages.professional_question: Which structural concept is credible enough to carry forward and what basis governs it?
entry_conditions: structural brief and information basis sufficient for concept comparison
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential load, ground, material, code and system knowledge before retaining a concept on professional grounds.

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when architectural option geometry or structural system basis materially changes.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current structural concept and MEP concept schematics/reserves
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when major plant, route, penetration or equipment-load strategy changes.

human_experience_consequences: span/depth/column/core consequences where they affect spatial use
design_language_consequences: exposed structural form/material consequences where design intent uses structure expressively
technical_consequences: system, stability, load, foundation, serviceability and durability concept
content_projection_requirements: show load path, stability system, major spans/zones and assumptions
required_readback: review real load paths, stability, major interfaces and assumption authority
stages.independent_review_requirement: Concept-stage design assurance/checking appropriate to project risk and novelty.
exit_conditions: credible concept selected at bounded concept ceiling
material assumptions and open items explicit

stages.professional_question: Is the structural design developed and coordinated enough that other disciplines can rely on its current geometry, movement and tolerance behavior?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount changed consequential design/code/source inputs before coordinated structural geometry is treated as current.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current coordinated structural and architectural models/drawings
current coordinated structural and MEP drawings/models
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when services, openings, equipment loads, supports or plant-base requirements change.

human_experience_consequences: member/core/column depth and position effects on use/circulation
content_projection_requirements: plans/sections at critical transfers, openings, movement and service interfaces
required_readback: actual coordinated model/drawings and critical sections
stages.independent_review_requirement: Stage-aware structural design assurance and checking of stability, load paths, assumptions and critical details.
open_items_allowed: later technical detail outside current spatial claim
exit_conditions: in-claim critical structural interfaces meet required Integration maturity

stages.professional_question: Is the permanent structural design technically complete at the declared responsibility boundary?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount current governing standards, project conditions, product/system evidence and specialist inputs before technical closure.

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen on material architectural geometry/opening/attachment/detail change.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current fire strategy/authority input plus technical structural design
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when controlling fire strategy or structural fire-resistance requirement changes.

technical_consequences: complete permanent-work technical design within responsibility
stages.independent_review_requirement: Required structural design checking / third-party checking according to risk, jurisdiction and appointment.
open_items_allowed: production/fabrication detail outside technical-design responsibility if explicitly assigned
exit_conditions: technical structural design and required checks close at declared responsibility boundary

stages.professional_question: Is technical structural design translated into coordinated production/manufacture information with specialist and temporary-works interfaces resolved to the required construction boundary?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential specialist/product/production evidence and changed design basis before production release decisions.

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when support/restraint/opening/base/load or installation sequence changes.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current specialist/fabricator production information plus structural review record
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when specialist design, fabrication or temporary-work assumptions change.

human_experience_consequences: retained clearances and exposed-detail effects where applicable
design_language_consequences: fabricated structural detail consequences where exposed
technical_consequences: production-ready structural information within assigned responsibility
content_projection_requirements: show specialist responsibility, temporary-work interface and unresolved production constraints
stages.professional_review_owner: Structural Engineering professional owner with assigned specialist reviewers
stages.independent_review_requirement: Review specialist/fabricator information and manufacturing/construction information according to checking plan.
exit_conditions: production/specialist information integrated to declared construction boundary

stages.professional_question: Does manufacture and construction conform to the current structural design intent within the observed and assigned scope, and are material nonconformities closed or explicitly held?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount current inspection/test/quality criteria and changed product/material evidence before accepting construction evidence.

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen on material nonconformity, substitution, sequence or as-constructed change.

content_projection_requirements: distinguish design intent, observed state, accepted deviation, unresolved nonconformity and field limits
required_readback: actual site/manufacture evidence for the claimed scope
stages.professional_review_owner: Structural Engineering professional owner within assigned construction-support scope
stages.independent_review_requirement: Inspection/witness/checking independence according to contract, risk, specification and statutory requirements.
open_items_allowed: explicit defects/nonconformities that block only the affected claim and remain tracked
exit_conditions: required observed construction/manufacture evidence and nonconformity decisions are current

stages.professional_question: Is the structural information required for handover, defect close, operation and future change current and bounded to the evidence actually available?
entry_conditions: construction sufficiently complete for structural handover decision
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount current handover/record requirements and final construction evidence before closure.

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when final as-constructed condition, defect status or maintenance requirement changes.

content_projection_requirements: co-locate handover status, known defects/limits and future inspection/change triggers
required_readback: final structural record set and defect/nonconformity status
stages.independent_review_requirement: Handover evidence review distinct from contractor self-declaration where required.
open_items_allowed: explicit later monitored/aftercare items with owner and claim boundary
exit_conditions: handover claim supported by current as-constructed/defect/evidence state

stages.professional_question: What does real use reveal about structural performance and which assumptions must be reopened or returned to G9?
entry_conditions: in-use structural question / observation / change triggered
knowledge_inputs: current code/source context for alteration or appraisal
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential observed evidence and current appraisal knowledge before drawing in-use structural conclusions.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: actual monitoring/inspection/use records plus current structural records
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen on new use/load, defect, damage, alteration, movement or monitoring evidence.

human_experience_consequences: vibration/movement/defect effects on use where observed
required_readback: actual monitoring/inspection/use evidence for the declared question
stages.independent_review_requirement: Appropriate independent appraisal/checking when in-use issue consequence requires it.
open_items_allowed: future unobserved performance remains outside each bounded assessment
exit_conditions: bounded in-use question assessed at its declared evidence ceiling
reopen_triggers: new use/load, alteration, movement, defect, damage or monitoring evidence

controlling_authority_requirements: each high-impact shared variable has one current authority
responsibility matrix resolves structural design ownership
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Actual enter/close maturity is resolved per interface / Acceptance Contract by Cross-Disciplinary Integration; SE-SPW stage number does not imply interface maturity or synchronise another domain stage.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: required maturity for current structural claim is met
open item and later owner are explicit
integration_readback_requirements: change propagation for material shared-variable changes

native_source_of_truth_rules: native engineering calculation/model/drawing remains authoritative within its declared scope
render/screenshot does not replace structural source
tool_adapter_requirements: Current Skill Resolver selects tools/capabilities; process does not hardcode software inventory
actual_readback_requirements: current native drawings/model/calculation state read back
site/manufacture evidence read back when claimed

assurance.professional_review: Structural stage review at declared claim ceiling, preserving structural responsibility and source assumptions.
assurance.evidence_review: Verify source/geotechnical/existing/material/product/construction evidence against claimed structural use.
assurance.independent_review: Risk-proportionate structural checking / independent review according to current professional guidance, jurisdiction, appointment and project complexity.

stale_scope_rules: only affected stages/interfaces/outputs become stale unless dependency graph shows wider consequence
upstream_impact_rules: a changed source/Basis of Structural Design assumption reopens all consuming structural decisions
downstream_impact_rules: changed structural controlled variables propagate to consuming Architecture/MEP/Envelope/Fire/Cost/FM interfaces
interface_reopen_rules: material shared-variable changes reopen affected Integration interfaces
receipt_stale_rules: receipt becomes stale at affected scope when governing source, stage output, checking basis or controlled variable changes

process_exit_conditions: applicable stage work complete at declared claim ceiling
open_items_allowed: explicit later/outside-claim items that do not contradict current structural verdict
completion_contract.promotion_effect: A current PASS may satisfy the triggered Structural Engineering professional-process dependency only at its bounded claim ceiling; it does not grant Design KEEP or Promotion.
